capabilities: Generate a JSONL file indexing every note's frontmatter, links, embeds, backlinks and broken links
Report vault-wide unresolved links, duplicate titles and orphan notes
Regenerate the map automatically on vault open or after note changes
Exclude files and folders with gitignore-like patterns
Compare the current map with the previous version and list changes
disambiguation: Not a graph view or visualization; it writes a machine-readable index file for tools outside Obsidian.
extras: Desktop only. Works entirely offline with no network requests. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: External tools must open and scan hundreds of notes to learn how a vault is linked, because Obsidian's metadata cache is not accessible to them.

relations.evidence: citation links to a passage, [text](obsidian://cite?note=…&q=…) (the format of the Better Citations plugin
It is meant for tools that work on your vault from the outside, such as scripts or AI coding agents

summary: Writes a JSON Lines index of every note's frontmatter, links, embeds, backlinks and broken links so external scripts and AI agents can read it.
